messages:
alex (CEO): FYI: all-hands this Wednesday 10:30am PT. Agenda: exec roadmap check, Dedicated GA window, a brief incident retrospective, two policy updates (external-demos + data-handling), and Q&A. Drop short questions here or use Notion: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands-input. Recording will be posted after. :calendar:

nina (CTO): We'll cover the KV cache fix and a small perf win from kernel tweaks. If you have one-line metrics to share, paste them here.

maya (VP Product): Launch owners: add a 1-line status to "Launch Callouts" by Tue EOD. We're doing 2 demo slots (3 mins each) so sign up if you need to show a short flow.

sam (People Ops): Policy heads-up: minor update to travel reimbursement process and the referral timing note. Full HR note here: https://hr.redwood/policies.

leo (Eng): Q: Will Dedicated GA include migration assistance for existing beta customers? Trying to plan team bandwidth.

rachel (Legal): Reminder: external-demo policy update means Marketing + Legal must approve any customer screenshots or partner logos before sharing. Turnaround target 48h for standard requests.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands Wed 10:30 PT. Recording + transcript auto-upload ~15m after meeting to /company/allhands.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks for joining. Recording: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1805002468. TL;DR: 1) Roadmap: focus on runtime cost-reduction and Developer Experience improvements. 2) Dedicated GA: target window early Sep, migration assistance offered for pilots. 3) Incident: root cause was KV cache eviction miscoordination; mitigations deployed. 4) Policies: external-demo approval flow + tightened data-handling checklist. 5) People: small travel/expense tweak + referral timing clarified.

nina (CTO): Incident recap: KV cache eviction race caused token duplication and p99 spikes. Fixes: coordinated eviction gate + safety tests; perf uplift ~10% p99 in our internal runs. Postmortem link will be posted in /incidents.

maya (VP Product): Dedicated GA notes: pilot customers get migration playbook and one scheduled onboarding session. Product will publish the GA checklist and signup link by next week.

rachel (Legal): New external-demo flow: submit draft assets to #marketing-press and tag Legal. For customer data demos include explicit consent. Standard review 48h.

sam (People Ops): Travel policy tweak: receipts timeline adjusted to 30 days; referrals: payout applies once hire passes probation. See HR doc for details.

alex (CEO): Q&A highlights: 
- Q: Will GA pricing differ for pilots? A: Pricing tiers will be announced with GA; pilots get a transitional offer.
- Q: Any follow-ups from the KV incident? A: Eng to publish postmortem + action tracker with owners by Mon.

leo (Eng): Thanks. Eng will attach owners/ETAs to the action tracker.

maya (VP Product): Action items: 1) Publish Dedicated GA checklist + signup by next week. 2) Product & Marketing: coordinate demo approvals with Legal. 3) Eng: postmortem + action tracker. 4) HR: update travel/referral FAQs. We'll post consolidated follow-up doc in Notion by EOD Friday. :rocket:
